item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 17/Oct/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will continue to affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, the area of low pressure over the central part of the South China Sea near Vietnam will develop gradually into a tropical cyclone, and move towards the vicinity of Beibu Wan. The associated rainbands will affect the coast of Guangdong. It will be slightly cooler over the region. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach southern China towards the weekend, bringing rainy weather to the region. With the strengthening of the anticyclone aloft, the weather will improve gradually over the coast of southern China early to midweek next week. It will be cooler in the morning and at night.
